desc:
Start in a rusty 50cc kart and race your way up to the Grand Prix!

🏁 Win the Amateur League, then fight through real league seasons: 125cc Kart, Shifter Kart and seven formula classes, from Junior Formula to the 1.6 V6 Hybrid Grand Prix.
🏆 Finish on the podium to get promoted. Every race is close: one more upgrade can make the difference!
🚙 Rally and GT Series side events: podium finishes win you rally and GT cars.
🔧 Upgrade engine, turbo, tyres and nitro, pick a SPEED or GRIP setup for every track, build your team HQ and hire your crew.
🔥 Drift for boost sparks, use nitro, slipstream and nail the rocket start.
🌍 Climb the World Ranking from Bronze to Champion (the world's top 200).
⚡ Server Showdowns every few minutes, a Daily Cup and a Weekly Time Trial.
🎖️ Season Pass with new rewards every season.
🤝 Fair racing: getting hit never costs you, and the bots give you room.

Codes: RACEDAY, TURBO
👍 Like the game and join the group for +10% Cash!
